Comet Construction requested a permit on October 1 for the $431,000 buildout. The store will sell spirits, beer, wine, mixers, and cocktail accessories.

Trulieve appears to have a new Atlanta location on the way, according to a recent permit filing. The dispensary is eyeing a space at 3790 Princeton Lakes Pkwy. Trulieve operates more than 200 dispensaries across the U.S.
The article notes Trulieve also has a location on the way to Cumming. No address or timing is given.

The Sweetish Fish is planning a second brick-and-mortar storefront in Boston's Seaport District. It will be the brand's largest location, offering Swedish and international candies plus seasonal desserts and beverages. The brand already operates a storefront at The Street at Chestnut Hill.

data.location: 12467 Rancho Bernardo Rd, San Diego, CA 92128
data.short_description: Leucadia Pizzeria is exploring a potential expansion into Rancho Bernardo, per public filings. Owner Charles Conover said plans are preliminary and an opening would be at least three months away if it proceeds. The company has not confirmed plans for a new restaurant.

Elegance Cocktail Bar is preparing to open in downtown Spokane with a grand opening on December 5. A liquor license application requests spirits, beer, and wine service. The 21+ venue will offer cocktails, craft beer, food, live music, DJs, and shuffleboard.

data.location: 301 E. Wallace Kneeland Boulevard, Shelton, WA 98584
data.short_description: Boom Boom Restaurant is preparing to open in Shelton. A liquor license application dated October 17 requests beer and wine service. Posts highlight breakfast items, burgers, salmon, and salads, but no opening date has been shared.

data.location: 31216 Pacific Highway S., Suite A, Federal Way, WA 98003
data.short_description: Stars Bar & Grill has changed hands following owner Teena Nelson's retirement after 36 years. Nelson announced plans to hand over the business on October 1. The space now operates under a new name.

data.location: 31216 Pacific Highway S., Suite A, Federal Way, WA 98003
data.short_description: The Groove Bar & Grill is now operating in the former Stars Bar & Grill space under new ownership. A liquor license application lists the new name. It is promoting a Halloween party, a November 4 darts tournament, and free-entry poker.

data.location: Address not specified (North County San Diego; Encinitas and Oceanside among possibilities)
data.status: expect to open their first North County location by the end of 2027
data.short_description: Wayfarer Bread & Pastry has partnered with Rise Collective to expand beyond its Bird Rock location. No specific site has been announced, with the first North County location expected by end of 2027. Founder Crystal White will transition into a creative director role.

data.location: Northeast corner of Ferrari Ranch Road and Lincoln Boulevard, Lincoln, CA 95648 (Ferrari Pavilion)
data.short_description: Jersey Mike's Subs is preparing to open in the new Ferrari Pavilion shopping center in Lincoln, listed as in development on its website. The center is expected to open in late 2027, per franchisee Anthony Wells. Other named tenants include Grocery Outlet, Starbucks, and Wendy's.
The article notes Jersey Mike's lists a Davis location among several coming soon in the Sacramento region. No address or timing is given.

data.location: 2240 N. Interstate Ave., Suite 260, Portland, OR 97227
data.status: hopes to welcome the public in December
data.short_description: La Casa de Mamá, a vegan Mexican bakery, is preparing its first storefront in North Portland's Eliot neighborhood. Renovations are expected to wrap up at the end of November, with a limited opening before a formal one. The space was previously occupied by Devil's Food Catering.

data.location: 6560 Garth Road, Baytown, TX 77521 (Baytown Plaza Shopping Center)
data.status: grand opening in spring or summer 2027
data.short_description: Bafang Dumpling is preparing to open its second Texas location in Baytown, per a TDLR permit filing. The company plans a grand opening with promotions and a ribbon-cutting in spring or summer 2027. The Taiwan-founded chain is known for potstickers and dumplings.

Al & Ernie's Bakery Cafe is opening a second location, Al & Ernie's in the Village, in Battle Ground Village. Remodeling is planned to start in late 2026, with a shorter menu of baked goods and coffee. The business is run by the Battle Ground Hospitality Collective.
Blue Castle Coffee previously occupied the space at 802 SE 14th Place. It left in August after choosing not to renew its lease.

The team at Marina's Bistro submitted a liquor license application for a new Marina's Supper Club concept at 4804 N Broadway. It is a new version of Chef Eric Roldan's current business and will offer elevated Puerto Rican cuisine and live music. The opening is planned for around February 2027, and the space is under construction.

Almusal is a new cafe concept from the Taninas family, who run Scarborough restaurant Coffee In, and it is preparing to open in Toronto. It will focus on coffee, matcha, all-day brunch, and lunch. The exact address and opening date have not been disclosed.

Dave and Tara Goldman, owners of Urban Village Brewing Co., plan to open Goldie's at 306 S. Main St. in Williamstown. It is planned as a "nostalgic neighborhood pub" and is still in the development phase. The team is targeting a 2027 debut.

Chubby World may be headed to 2646 Dupont Dr in Irvine, according to the Orange County Health Department's plan review database. The multi-level development from Chubby Group is planned to include a music hall, anime retail, a Hashi Market fresh market, a food court, and a theater. No confirmed opening date has been provided.

Christine Kim's Noona's will open at 203 W. 20th St. in Chelsea as her first brick-and-mortar location. By day it will be an Asian wellness retailer and café serving coffee, tea, smoothies, and Korean bone broth. Around 4 p.m. it will switch to a wine bar serving Korean tapas.

Annapurna Cafe is preparing to relocate from 1833 Broadway to a street-level space in the Brix building at 538 Broadway E, which currently houses Star Sushi & Bar. The plans include a kitchen overhaul and an interior redesign, subject to city approval. No opening date has been announced.

Annapurna Cafe plans to move out of its below-street-level dining room at 1833 Broadway, where it has operated since May 2003. For now, the restaurant continues to operate at this location. The owners do not yet know when the move will happen.

data.location: 47 E. Main St., Los Gatos, CA 95030
data.short_description: Morning Lobby is preparing to open a second cafe at 47 E. Main St. in Los Gatos, with an expected opening in January 2027. The new location will be larger than the original San Jose shop and will seat about 60 guests indoors, plus a small outdoor parklet. The menu is expected to resemble the San Jose location's breakfast and specialty coffee offerings.

data.location: SanTan Crossing, southeast corner of SanTan Village Parkway and Williams Field Road, Gilbert
data.short_description: The Capital Grille is preparing to open at SanTan Crossing in Gilbert, according to East Valley Now. The company plans a 9,134-square-foot freestanding restaurant at the southeast corner of SanTan Village Parkway and Williams Field Road. No opening date has been announced.
